name: opencode
reviewCommand: opencode run --archived --agent ndev-diff-reviewer --file {brief} 'Review the change as the attached brief says.' > {out}
askHuman: Ask the human in the chat and end your turn.
notes: opencode v2 (also called opencode2) reads skills from ~/.config/opencode/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills; the skill id is the folder name, and a later source overrides the same id. Agents are ~/.config/opencode/agents/<id>.md with description, mode (primary, subagent or all) and permissions; the id is the file name. The instructions file is AGENTS.md only. There are no shell hooks: plugins are TypeScript in ~/.config/opencode/plugins. In v2.3.0 the skill listing (opencode api --standalone GET /api/skill) returned an empty list even for installed skills, so do not trust it as a check.
